The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional ATC Clause – On-Site Testing & Demonstration ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) Item: Supply of Surface Mounting Pressure Gauges 1. The Pressure Gauges shall be brand new, unused, genuine and of the latest manufacturing standard. Us ed, refurbished or reconditioned items shall not be accepted. 2. The supplied Pressure Gauges shall be of industrial-grade quality and suitable for reliable operation und er the specified working conditions. 3. The Pressure Gauges shall conform to relevant BIS/ISI standards or applicable international standards su ch as EN 837 or equivalent, wherever applicable. 4. The Pressure Gauges shall have a clear and easily readable dial, durable construction, corrosion- resistant casing and suitable mounting arrangement.

5. The supplied items shall strictly comply with the technical specifications, pressure measuring range, dial size, accuracy class, connection type and mounting arrangement specified in the bid. 6. The bidder shall submit the manufacturer's technical datasheet, product catalogue and detailed specific ations along with the technical bid for verification. 7. The supplier shall provide a valid calibration certificate traceable to NABL-accredited or equivalent labor atory, wherever applicable. 8. The supplier shall ensure proper packing and safe transportation to prevent physical damage, moisture i ngress or any other damage during transit. 9. A minimum warranty of 12 months from the date of successful installation/acceptance shall be provided by the supplier. 10. Any defective, damaged or non-conforming item shall be replaced by the supplier free of cost within 1 5 days of notification by the consignee. 11. The supplier shall arrange an authorized technical representative to visit the consignee's premises for on-site testing, inspection and demonstration of the supplied Pressure Gauges. 12. The supplier shall physically demonstrate the proper functioning, pressure indication, accuracy and op erational performance of each supplied Pressure Gauge in the presence of the consignee's authorized repr esentative. 13. Necessary testing equipment, tools and technical manpower required for testing and demonstration sh all be arranged by the supplier at their own cost. 14. The supplier shall submit the relevant testing reports and calibration certificates for verification by the consignee. 15. The supplied Pressure Gauges shall be considered accepted only after successful on-site testing, demo nstration and satisfactory verification by the consignee's authorized representative. 16. All expenses towards the supplier's visit, transportation, testing, demonstration and technical support s hall be borne by the supplier without any additional financial liability to the consignee. 17. The consignee reserves the right to reject any item that does not conform to the specified technical re quirements or fails during testing and demonstration. 18. Delivery shall be completed within the stipulated delivery period mentioned in the bid. 19. Payment shall be processed as per applicable GeM terms and conditions after successful delivery, testi ng, inspection and acceptance of the supplied items. 20. All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC). 21. The supplier shall arrange for on-site testing and demonstration of the supplied Pressure Gauges at the consignee's premises. The supplier's authorized technical representative shall visit the site and carry out n ecessary testing and verification to demonstrate the proper functioning, accuracy and performance of the supplied Pressure Gauges. 22. The supplier shall demonstrate the functioning of each supplied Pressure Gauge in the presence of the consignee's authorized representative and submit the relevant test reports/calibration certificates for verifi cation. 23. The supplied items shall be considered accepted only after successful on-site testing, demonstration a nd satisfactory verification by the consignee. 24. All expenses related to the supplier's visit, testing, demonstration and necessary arrangements shall b e borne by the supplier without any additional cost to the consignee. .
